title: Consistent Torches
description: All torches get the new 1.21.2 redstone torch effect.
body:
# Description
Consistent Torches makes all the torches have the same effect as the 1.21.2+ redstone torch.

### WARNING
This pack will most likely be incompatible with any other resource packs that changes torches models unless this pack is on top. This pack also doesn't change any of the redstone torch models, so if you have an old redstone torch texture pack this will not work.

## Creation
Recreates the same outline effect of the redstone torch in Blockbench by making the outer texture to transparent in the UV settings. (`UV > Texture > Transparent`)
